run_esm2_protein_embeddings: load esm2_t33_650M_UR50D model and extract per-residue representations from protein sequences
run_esmfold_structure_prediction: load esmfold_v1 model and infer PDB structure from a protein amino acid sequence
run_extract_protein_embeddings: run scripts/extract.py to extract embeddings from a FASTA file using esm1_t34_670M_UR50S
run_msa_transformer_inference: load esm_msa1_t12_100M_UR50S model and process multiple sequence alignment data for representations
run_variant_prediction: run predict.py with esm1v models to score protein variants using a DMS CSV input
